name: Menu
description: A list of choices that opens from a button: a Popover with role="menu" and MenuItem rows, the chosen one checked, with the menu keys (ArrowDown on the trigger opens; arrows wrap; Home/End; Enter or Space selects and closes; Escape, Tab or a press outside closes, focus back on the trigger).
usage: Use for a short list of choices or actions that belongs to one button: a project switcher, a sort order, a row's actions
Pass items as data ({ value, label, end?, disabled? }); onSelect gets the value and the menu closes after it
Pass value for a pick-one menu: the chosen row is checked and focus starts on it
Pass the trigger as a render prop and spread its props onto your own button (they include onKeyDown, for ArrowDown)
end holds status at the row's end (a ring, marks); it is part of the row, so a press on it selects. Not for controls of its own
Not for a form or a few controls (use Popover), a list that filters as you type, or nested submenus (not supported)
examples:
<Menu label="Project" items={projects.map(p => ({ value: p.name, label: p.name, end: <Ring working={p.working} /> }))}
  value={current} onSelect={pickProject} portal={false} alignOffset={6} className="min-w-[13rem]"
  trigger={p => <button {...p}>{current} <ChevronDown size={14} /></button>} />
design: Popover's surface and motion: --color-surface-elevated, --elevation-3 with a 1px --color-border-subtle ring, --radius-lg; grows out of the trigger (recipe.morph) and collapses back
Content padding --space-3xs (0.25rem); width to fit, className sets a min width
Rows are MenuItem buttons at size md (type-label), 2.25rem tall, --space-2xs side padding, --radius-md corner, muted text
Hover: --color-state-hover; keyboard focus: --color-state-active with default text, no ring; the chosen row default text at 600
The row's end: the item's end content, then a 14px check slot that every row keeps in a pick-one menu, so the columns line up
accessibility: The trigger gets aria-haspopup="menu", aria-expanded, and aria-controls naming the menu while open (Popover)
The panel is role="menu" named by label. With value the rows are menuitemradio with aria-checked (a pick-one menu); without, plain menuitem
Rows have tabIndex -1: focus moves by the keys, not by Tab. Focus starts on the chosen row, else the first enabled one
ArrowDown/ArrowUp move through enabled rows and wrap at both ends; Home/End go to the first and last; Enter or Space selects and closes
Escape, a press outside, or Tab / Shift+Tab from any row closes it, and focus goes back to the trigger
Disabled rows carry aria-disabled="true", are skipped by the keys and do nothing when pressed

props.name: trigger
props.description: Renders the trigger; spread the given ref, onClick, onKeyDown and aria props onto a button.

props.name: items
props.description: The rows: { value: string; label: ReactNode; end?: ReactNode; disabled?: boolean }.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen item: checked, focused at open; makes the rows menuitemradio.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: A row's click, Enter or Space; the menu closes after it.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Leave out for uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the trigger, ArrowDown, a selection, Escape, Tab or a press outside asks to open or close.

props.name: placement
props.description: Popover's: the preferred side; flips when it has no room.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Popover's: gap from the trigger, in px.

props.name: alignOffset
props.description: Popover's: how far the menu reaches past the trigger's aligned edge, in px (the switcher: 6, its names under the label).

props.name: viewportMargin
props.description: Popover's: least distance from the window's edges, in px.

props.name: portal
props.description: Popover's: portalled above dialogs, or false beside the trigger (a trigger in a static bar only).

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the menu's box (min width, width).
